newsitem.title: USA: Southeastern Michigan Gas to change name.
newsitem.headline: Southeastern Michigan Gas to change name.

text.p: Southeastern Michigan Gas Enterprises Inc said Wednesday will change its name to Semco Energy Inc to improve its brand identity and reduce confusion among regulators, suppliers and vendors.

The company said it also plans to ask shareholders for approval of a long-term incentive plan at the company's annual meeting in April. The plan provides stock options and other stock-based awards for management and directors if certain financial targets are met.
Shareholder approval is also required for the name change and a shareholder rights plan, which provides for the authorization of additional preferred stock.
Southeastern Michigan Gas is the parent firm of Battle Creek Gas Co, Michigan Gas Co and Southeastern Michigan Gas Co. The companies serve 228,000 customers throughout Michigan.
